source: Direct user decision in this task; Sanctuary deviations take precedence.
userReport: native UO mobs that don't have a D2 equivalent, we'll have to categorise by relative strength i guess
approvedPolicy: Classify native UO monsters without a direct D2 equivalent by relative strength for Sanctuary adaptation. Do not present a strength-tier assignment as a literal D2 species match.
implementationStatus: Policy recorded; tier thresholds and individual assignments are not implemented or verified.
assignmentRequirements: Retain the original UO creature identity and abilities; a strength category is not an instruction to replace the creature.
Keep provenance explicit: direct counterpart versus Sanctuary relative-strength classification.
Document uncertain assignments and continue unaffected skills.
Choose and verify tier criteria before enabling any currently unmapped creature in source-species-dependent mechanics.
scopeLimit: This decision does not by itself assign Revive eligibility, D2 special flags, AI, immunity, rewards or summon statistics to an unmapped UO creature.
